text.ja: Michaelis–Mentenと完全酵素反応系 E+S\mathrel{\mathop{\rightleftharpoons}^{k_1}_{k_{-1}}}C\mathrel{\mathop{\longrightarrow}^{k_2}}E+P v=V_{\max}S/(K_M+S) 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 限定した実行例：2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
text.en: Michaelis–Menten and full enzyme kinetics E+S\mathrel{\mathop{\rightleftharpoons}^{k_1}_{k_{-1}}}C\mathrel{\mathop{\longrightarrow}^{k_2}}E+P v=V_{\max}S/(K_M+S) Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.
